plan.summary: This 4-week block is the first checkpoint of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan built around general strength, power, and clean movement quality. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lifts with one assessment lift per session, then Weeks 2-3 build force and power with simple repeatable work, and Week 4 deloads by cutting volume while keeping intent sharp. Main program loading starts in Week 2 after Week 1 sets your baselines.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baselines, build basic strength, and layer in simple explosive work without excessive fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Push the main strength lifts and medicine-ball power work higher while keeping recovery in line with boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Convert the earlier strength gains into faster, sharper outputs with lower fatigue and more speed emphasis.
